lines.text: Many learners say: I will do diet.
Better: I will go on a diet.
On! I will go on a diet.

data.right: I will go on a diet.

native.tip: 다이어트하다는 do diet가 아니라 go on a diet예요!
native.caption: “I will do diet”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 ‘다이어트를 하다’는 go on a diet라는 표현으로 말해요. “I will go on a diet”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: Do not say do diet. Say “I will go on a diet”.
en.caption: Do you say “I will do diet”? 😅 English says “go on a diet”, not “do diet”. “I will go on a diet” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
